name: Set up a new machine
summary: First run on a new machine: the setup check, the canvas shortcut, the owner's accounts and folders.

nodes.title: Run the setup check
nodes.body: `python scripts/doctor.py` prints one line per check and exits 1 if any fails.

nodes.title: Add the canvas shortcut
nodes.body:
- `python playbook/install_shortcut.py` (`--remove` takes it away).
- Any OS: `python playbook/launch.pyw`.

nodes.title: Register the accounts
nodes.sub: Handles only: never passwords or emails
nodes.body:
- Canvas: **Accounts**, then **Add account**, or duplicate the demo ones and edit them.
- Delete the demo accounts once yours are in.

nodes.title: Point the folders at real paths
nodes.body: Canvas: **Folders**, then edit each path. Every step that uses a folder picks up the change.
